name: Sana
source:
The youngest girl in the village.

When Len first showed up, Sana was unsure how to talk to her and ended up acting coldly. Despite that, Len kept treating her like a friend. 

Having lived her whole life in an isolated village filled with older people, this was something Sana never had the opportunity to experience before. She is now finding herself inceasingly drawn to the older girl.

Shinonome, Ruka and Uzume spoil her like she were their own younger sister.

[Translated from [url=https://k-yomiji.sakura.ne.jp/kyouhime/#a_chara]the official description.[/url]]
